_comment: Every Exanima address the ExCamera player build uses. RVAs and reviewed_signatures belong to the source_sha256 archive (Exanima 0.9.5.2g, Steam build 25803178). generate validates all reviewed patterns and emits the header without rediscovering or dropping fallbacks. target_order preserves the runtime enum; slots retain independent held-function checks. Editing native evidence requires review and executable validation.

navSampler.note: camera controller's sampler; replaced through navSlot

headRenderSample.note: controlled head render sampler; uses the camera's native sample offset and writes mesh+A0

playerBehavior.note: player behaviour tick; replaced through behaviorSlot

combatAttention.note: native perceived-opponent scoring/publication; scoped close-view aim direction, native head gaze restored

dragRotate.note: held-item orientation before ordinary world placement and inventory placement

propagateNodePose.note: native local-to-parent node propagation after held-item rotation

heldQuery.note: ordinary world hold query; native placement and accepted-pose storage follow this call

copyCameraSnapshots.note: native camera/player cache publication retained when cameraMouse is bypassed

sampledViews.note: EXP_render_sampled_views: renders the world for one view; hooked so view effects run after the world pass, before bloom and UI

superSampledViews.note: FUN_10004B6D0: the supersampled world pass; averages its jittered samples into the default framebuffer, leaving the last sample's depth

sampledViewsWorldReturn.note: viewport presentation 0x4BAB0 -> sampledViews(view, 0): the ordinary single-sample world pass

heldItemRelease.note: ordinary free-item pointer-release handler; optional XR grip release sends message 0x80 at the owned presentation boundary

xrCompose.note: native affine composition; scoped pose-builder local target input for native motors

xrGrabStart.note: native grab initialization; scoped controller pick

xrPhysicalCommit.note: Physical VR contact bookkeeping only; no native attack request or animation dispatch.

xrPhysicalContact.note: Physical VR contact bookkeeping only; no native attack request or animation dispatch.

xrPhysicalImpact.note: Physical VR contact bookkeeping only; no native attack request or animation dispatch.

motionPlay.note: The character motion player 179EE0(character, motion, blend_ms, force): no state gates of its own; ends the current motion, resets the attack bookkeeping, sets the physics mode for kick/jump and stores the motion at +9B8. Used only by the VR kick, which brings its own gates. Same bytes as attackVariants::transitionClosure.

attachChild.note: Scene tree attach 50170(parent, child): detaches from the old parent, appends to the child list (+0x118/+0x120), sets parent (+0x128) and the owning sector (+0x130) down the branch. Used only by the VR finger bones.

boneRegister.note: Skin bone register D39B0(skin, node): returns the id at node+0x17C when set, else appends the node transform pointer, an inverse bind from the current world transforms and a float to the three skin arrays (FPC SetLength) and stores the 1-based id at node+0x17C. Used only by the VR finger bones.

silhouettePass.note: FUN_10004F1D0: the camera pass's highlight pass, called once from FUN_10004F750 after the opaque and blended lists; hooked so the player's hidden body is marked in a mask while the pass's camera is current

cameraPass.note: FUN_10004F750: one camera's world pass (lists, events, highlight pass)

materialBind.note: FUN_100073F20: binds a material (current material, blend, textures, vertex arrays, cull); the colour pass calls it before queueing that material's entries

sampledViewsOffscreenReturn.note: viewport presentation 0x4BAB0 -> sampledViews(view, setting) when view+206 is set: the offscreen supersampled world pass, resolved into the view texture

silhouetteSingleSubmit.note: FUN_100200770(world renderer, node, part): the single-sample submit (per-node uniforms, program, textures) that 0x201630 dispatches to when DAT_10049ACB0 < 1; whole body contracted as headwearNative_200770

rigidImpulse.note: Rigid-body push 89240(body, vec3, weights[4], wake): adds vec x weight[i] to each of the body tetra points (+F0) through 7DB30, a Verlet velocity change of vec per step; with the last flag it adds |vec| to +448 and wakes the body past a threshold. Force Blast (2313D0) uses it. Used only by the VR jump.

characterMove.note: Character move 170810(character, transform48, flag): copies the transform (basis, position at +24) to +9F0, writes position +AB4 and its copies, resets motion bookkeeping and stamina +10B8, moves every part and its motor targets, and with the flag also the anchors +B40/+B4C/+B58. Used by arrival placement 180160, knock-out placement 124480/182340 and device paths 1A0710. Used only by the VR teleport.

nodeCtor.note: T3DNode constructor 4FD20(vmt, 1): NewInstance through the class table, node init, no mesh streams; the plain scene node the game builds for its own node copies (502D0). Its class slot +D0 (511B0) only sets flag bit 1, unlike TMesh +D0 (5F860), which logs "Mesh has no faces". Used only by the finger bones.

skinBuild.note: Skin build D9940(tree, skin**, data): new _SKIN aggregate node and skin object, bones counted (D9D20) and filled (D9C50), then the aggregate builder D6080 merges every TMesh child whose +204 & 0xC00000 == 0x400000 (set by E7550 from the model bit 0x40) as its own bone. Called only from the equipment refresh (E7F13). Hooked only to mark rigid hand pieces (gloves, gauntlets) skinnable before it runs.
